name: plural-with-parts-and-count
template: t`${plural({ count }, { one: part`${n} file`, other: part`${n} files` })}`

name: plural-with-text-branches
template: t`${plural({ count }, { '=0': 'No files', one: `One file`, 2: "A pair", other: 'Many files' })}`

name: plural-with-options
template: t({ context: 'inbox' })`${plural({ count }, { one: 'One message', other: 'Many messages' })}`

name: plural-with-a-typed-variable
template: t`${plural(({ count }) as { count: number }, { one: 'One file', other: 'Many files' })}`

name: selectordinal
template: t`You finished ${selectordinal({ place }, { one: part`${n}st`, two: part`${n}nd`, few: part`${n}rd`, other: part`${n}th` })}!`

name: select-in-text
template: t`Signed in as ${select({ role }, { admin: 'an admin', other: 'a member' })}`

name: nested-plural-and-select
template: t`${plural({ count }, { one: part`${n} new message for ${select({ role }, { admin: 'admins', other: 'everyone' })}`, other: part`${n} new messages for ${{ name }}` })}`

name: number-with-options-and-context
template: t`Total: ${number({ price }, { style: 'currency', currency, currencyDisplay: 'code', maximumFractionDigits: 1 })}`

name: time
template: t`Starts at ${time({ due }, { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false })}`

name: anonymous-plural-count
template: t`${plural(count, { one: 'One file', other: part`${n} files` })}`

name: anonymous-value-inside-a-part
template: t`${plural({ count }, { one: 'One file', other: part`${n} files for ${name}` })}`

name: part-behind-a-constant
template: t`${plural({ count }, { one: 'One file', other: tail })}`

name: branch-with-a-type-assertion
template: t`${plural({ count }, { one: 'One file' as string, other: 'Many files' })}`

name: unbuildable-count-in-a-select-branch
template: t`${select({ role }, { admin: part`${n} files`, other: 'No files' })}`
